requirements.title: Expiration Policy Engine
requirements.description: Session expiration policy engine supports never-expire (default), preset TTL durations (1h, 8h, 24h), and custom duration. Policies evaluated on session access and periodic sweep.

validation.notes: Test policy enforcement for each mode (never, preset, custom) + validation, TTL resolution, expiration checks, sweeper
Sweeper Start() is idempotent — no double goroutine leak
Sweeper loop fires and removes expired sessions end-to-end

requirements.title: Policy Configuration UI
requirements.description: Per-workspace and per-session policy configuration UI in drawer. Shows current policy, allows modification, displays countdown for TTL sessions.

validation.notes: Policy option parsing covers never and preset modes and rejects invalid selections
Session management renders the policy selector and calls updateSessionPolicy
Session policy dropdown triggers updateSessionPolicy for preset and never modes

requirements.title: Countdown Timer Display
requirements.description: Real-time countdown timer displays remaining TTL for sessions with preset or custom expiration policies. Updates every second.

validation.notes: Duration parsing and countdown formatting verified
useCountdown hook returns null for never, countdown string for TTL, expired for past-due, cleans up interval
